papers.title: Polar Cryogenic Impact Behavior of Selective Laser Melted Ti-6Al-4V Alloy: Effects of Scanning Strategies and Notch Orientation
papers.abstract: The anisotropic mechanical properties of selective laser melting (SLM)-processed Ti-6Al-4V (TC4) alloy hinder its deployment in polar marine equipment. This study systematically probes the relationships between laser scanning strategies (unidirectional vs. 67°-rotated scanning between layers), notch orientation (governing loading direction), and cryogenic impact energy of SLM-TC4. Charpy impact tests from -60 °C to 20 °C were performed on V-notched specimens fabricated with distinct scanning strategies and notch orientations (top/side surfaces). The analysis of impact energy data and macro/micro-fractography demonstrates that impact energy declines markedly with decreasing temperature, showing a 25-35% reduction at -60 °C versus 20 °C while exhibiting enhanced data consistency under cryogenic conditions. Notably, specimens fabricated with 67°-rotated scanning between layers achieve higher impact toughness than unidirectionally scanned equivalents. Moreover, for identical scanning strategies, side-notched specimens consistently outperform top-notched specimens, evidencing superior interfacial bonding strength between deposited layers relative to bonding within individual layers. Within individual layers, toughness normal to the laser scan path exceeds that parallel to the path. However, controlling ductile-to-brittle transition behavior and precluding brittle failure are imperative for SLM-TC4 components in polar cryogenic service. This work delivers essential quantitative benchmarks and experimental validation for optimizing SLM processing in critical polar vessel components.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了选区激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V的低温冲击性能，包含扫描策略和缺口取向的影响，属于L1层力学性能研究。
llm.why_not_core: Does not cover fatigue life, S-N curves, or tensile properties; focuses solely on Charpy impact toughness.

summary_zh.motivation: 选区激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V在极地海洋装备应用中面临各向异性问题，需系统研究低温冲击性能。
summary_zh.method: 制备单向和67°旋转扫描策略的V型缺口试样，在-60°C至20°C进行夏比冲击试验。
summary_zh.result: 冲击能量随温度降低下降25-35%，67°旋转扫描和侧缺口试样表现出更高韧性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过冲击能量数据和断口宏微观形貌分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: The anisotropic mechanical properties of SLM-processed Ti-6Al-4V hinder its application in polar marine equipment, necessitating a systematic study of cryogenic impact behavior.
summary_en.method: Charpy impact tests from -60°C to 20°C were conducted on V-notched specimens fabricated with unidirectional and 67°-rotated scanning strategies and different notch orientations.
summary_en.result: Impact energy decreased by 25-35% at -60°C compared to 20°C; 67°-rotated scanning and side-notched specimens exhibited higher impact toughness.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through impact energy data combined with macro- and micro-fractography analysis.

papers.title: Microstructural Characterization of Ceramic-Reinforced Ti–6Al–4V Alloys using SEM, EDS Mapping, and EBSD Techniques
papers.abstract: Abstract This study examines the improvements in microstructure and hardness of Ti-6Al-4V alloys reinforced with 5 wt% TiN and TiB₂. These ceramic reinforcements were incorporated through spark plasma sintering (SPS). Adding Cr and Ni significantly refines the β-phase microstructure and stabilizes its distribution. Meanwhile, TiN particles serve as effective nucleation sites, and the in situ TiB₂ whiskers help pin grain boundaries, promoting dynamic recrystallization. EBSD analysis shows a marked reduction in grain size, decreasing from 8.91 μm in the unreinforced alloy to 5.27 μm in the composite. This analysis also reveals a weak crystallographic texture and a predominance of low-angle grain boundaries, indicative of sub-grain formation. The combined effects of grain boundary refinement, dispersion strengthening from TiN and TiB₂ particles, and β-phase stabilization through the addition of Cr and Ni lead to a significant increase in hardness, rising from 353 HV 0.2 in the matrix alloy to 592 HV 0.2 in the composite.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是通过放电等离子烧结（SPS）制备的陶瓷增强Ti-6Al-4V复合材料，而非增材制造（LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED）材料，与方向不符。
llm.why_not_core: Paper uses spark plasma sintering (SPS), not additive manufacturing (LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED), and focuses on microstructure and hardness rather than mechanical/fatigue characterization relevant to AM Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索TiN和TiB₂陶瓷增强Ti-6Al-4V的显微组织与硬度改善。
summary_zh.method: 通过放电等离子烧结（SPS）制备5 wt% TiN和TiB₂增强的Ti-6Al-4V复合材料。
summary_zh.result: 晶粒尺寸从8.91 μm细化至5.27 μm，硬度从353 HV 0.2提升至592 HV 0.2。
summary_zh.validation: 使用SEM、EDS和EBSD进行显微组织表征，并进行硬度测试。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the improvements in microstructure and hardness of Ti-6Al-4V alloys reinforced with 5 wt% TiN and TiB₂, processed via spark plasma sintering.
summary_en.method: Ceramic reinforcements (TiN and TiB₂) were incorporated into Ti-6Al-4V through spark plasma sintering (SPS), with Cr and Ni additions to refine β-phase.
summary_en.result: Grain size reduced from 8.91 μm to 5.27 μm, and hardness increased from 353 HV 0.2 to 592 HV 0.2 due to grain refinement and dispersion strengthening.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization was performed using SEM, EDS mapping, and EBSD, and hardness was measured via Vickers indentation.

papers.title: Influence of Frictional Behavior Under MQL on Cutting Process in Shoulder Milling Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: Titanium alloys are commonly applied to aerospace parts because of their high specific strength, heat resistance, and corrosion resistance. To develop cost-effective and reliable parts, it is crucial to achieve high-quality and productive machining of titanium alloys. It is important to control the cutting force to achieve a good surface finish and minimize tool wear. The interaction between the tool and chip significantly influences the cutting force. This study focuses on the influence of the frictional behavior of minimum quantity lubrication (MQL) on cutting force and chip formation in shoulder milling of Ti-6Al-4V. The milling process under the MQL condition is compared to those under dry and high-pressure flood coolant conditions in the cutting tests. The cutter feed and normal components in the cutting force under the MQL condition become smaller in comparison with those of the other lubrication conditions. Regarding the chip morphology, the curl radius becomes small in milling under the MQL condition, while the chip forms with a large radius in milling under dry condition. This suggests that the small friction coefficient increases the chip flow velocity closer to the rake face in milling under the MQL condition. The effect of lubrication on the cutting force is analyzed with a force model based on the minimum cutting energy. The model is verified through comparison between the simulated and measured cutting forces. Comparative analysis of friction angles in MQL, flood coolant, and dry milling conditions indicates that the angle in MQL milling is reduced by approximately 2° and 3° compared to that in the flood and dry conditions, respectively.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铣削过程中的摩擦行为，未涉及后处理对疲劳或力学性能的影响。
llm.why_not_core: The paper studies cutting mechanics in shoulder milling, not the effect of post-processing on fatigue or mechanical performance of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究钛合金铣削过程中摩擦行为对切削力的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过干式、高压冷却和MQL条件下肩铣Ti-6Al-4V实验，对比切削力和切屑形态。
summary_zh.result: MQL条件下切削力减小，切屑卷曲半径变小，摩擦角降低约2-3°。
summary_zh.validation: 通过最小切削能量模型与实测切削力对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of frictional behavior under minimum quantity lubrication (MQL) on cutting force and chip formation in shoulder milling of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Cutting experiments were conducted under dry, high-pressure flood coolant, and MQL conditions, measuring cutting force and chip morphology.
summary_en.result: MQL reduced cutting force and chip curl radius, and decreased the friction angle by approximately 2-3° compared to other conditions.
summary_en.validation: A cutting force model based on minimum cutting energy was validated against experimental measurements.
